errors.bad_args: Sitemap capture got arguments it cannot read: {reason}
errors.bad_date: {pattern} is no date; write it as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.bad_rewrite: {pattern} is no http or https origin to rewrite the URLs to.
errors.bad_url: {url} is no http or https URL.
errors.fetch: The sitemap could not be fetched.
errors.not_a_sitemap: The file is no sitemap, sitemap index or URL list.
errors.private_address: The sitemap is on this machine or the local network while the site is not, and is not read.
errors.redirect_invalid: The redirect names no usable URL.
errors.redirect_origin: The redirect leads to another host or port and is not followed.
errors.redirect_scheme: The redirect leaves http for https or the other way round and is not followed.
errors.too_deep: The sitemap indexes are nested deeper than allowed.
errors.too_large: The sitemap is larger than allowed.
errors.too_many_patterns: Too many include or exclude patterns.
errors.xml: The sitemap is no well-formed XML (or has a DTD).

tools.discover: Finds a site's sitemaps (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, indexes, gzip) or reads a given sitemap, file or URL list, and answers the pages a capture would take after the patterns, languages, lastmod, sampling and the environment rewrite. Captures nothing.
tools.gallery: Renders the HTML gallery of a sitemap capture run from its run.json. Writes nothing.
